overall_status: PARTIAL_MATCH: the six-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4's ParamListStandard per-space findEntry, the no-filter unjustifiedContainer/assumedExtension, the operator< sort ladder and the split address/flags/slot mechanics. Overall stays PARTIAL_MATCH for three registered residuals outside the covered projection: (1) trial absolute slot base - Ghidra slots are 1-based (fspec.cc:4062 triallist[trial.getSlot()-1]) while Rugra's ParamActive slotbase starts at 0 with len-based registerTrial slots and 0-based consumer coupling; the fixture observes slot deltas only. (2) unjustifiedContainer/assumedExtension accept legacy spaceless query addresses, so a foreign-space query at a matching offset can false-positive where Ghidra's per-entry Address space checks reject it (ADDRESS-0001 bridge gap). (3) Rust's stable sort_by may order comparator-equal trials differently from libstdc++ introsort.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-fspec-phase0-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5 (IPTR_SPACEBASE); byte addressed, wordsize 1
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/SpaceRegistry insert ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace and AddrSpace register/ram (IPTR_PROCESSOR) + stack (IPTR_SPACEBASE) with the canonical indices; little-endian to match Rugra's coarse AddressSpace default

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; four staged ParamEntry resources (register g0/g1 exclusion force-left, stack g2 alignment-8 reverse, ram g3 exclusion force-left smallsize)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamListStandard via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters); populateResolver/finalize_after_decode complete the model

analysis_options.api: Direct production ParamListStandard::possibleParamWithSlot/unjustifiedContainer/assumedExtension and ParamActive registerTrial/setEntry/sortTrials/splitHi/splitLo/splitTrial calls; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.normalization: None. Exact hit booleans, slot/slotsize ints, container (space,offset,size) triples, opcode names, post-sort (addr,size,group,offset) rows and split (addr,size,slot-delta,flag) rows are printed verbatim
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs (the guarded splitTrial placeholder throw is covered by Rugra unit tests, not this fixture)

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: 12 possibleParamWithSlot queries over the four-space model
cases.queries: register 0x30/8 and 0x30/4 (justified, force-left), 0x34/4 (unjustified), 0x30/2 (below minsize), 0x48/8 (no entry); stack 0x8/8 and 0x10/4 (reverse slot math), 0x100/8 (beyond entry); ram 0x2000/16 (full hit), 0x30/8 (register offset inside ram: cross miss); unique 0x30/8 and const 0x2000/8 (cross miss)
cases.expect: register and stack entries hit with the Ghidra slot/slotsize arithmetic; const/unique/ram cross-offset queries never hit (per-space resolverMap semantics)

cases.queries: register 0x34/4 and 0x32/4 (unjustified -> container (register,0x30,8)); register 0x30/4 (justified -> false); ram 0x2008/8 (-> (ram,0x2000,16)); stack 0x2/8 (alignment arithmetic -> (stack,0x0,16))
cases.expect: no space filter: register and ram entries both serve their own queries; minsize gate respected

cases.queries: register 0x38/4 (smallsize_zext -> INT_ZEXT); ram 0x2000/8 (smallsize_inttype -> PIECE); register 0x30/4 (no smallsize flags -> COPY); ram 0x2004/8 (unjustified -> COPY); register 0x38/8 (sz >= size -> COPY)
cases.expect: no space filter: the register-entry zext is reachable; COPY gates (flags, size, justification) hold

cases.setup: 6 trials registered in raw-address order then setEntry-bound: stack 0x10/8 and 0x0/8 (entry 2), register 0x38/4 (entry 1), register 0x30/8 and 0x34/4 (entry 0, offsets 0 and 4), register 0x50/8 (no entry)
cases.expect: operator< ladder: group 0 offset 0 before offset 4, then group 1, then reverse-stack group 2 (0x10 before 0x0), entry-less trial last

cases.setup: 12-byte register trial marked used+active; splitHi(4), splitLo(4), splitLo(8)
cases.expect: hi keeps (addr,size,slot) and inherits flags; lo starts at addr+(size-sz): 0x100+8=0x108 for sz=4 (not addr+sz=0x104), size sz, slot+1, flags inherited; the complementary sz=8 piece is 0x104/8

cases.setup: ParamActive with 12-byte used+active trial and an 8-byte survivor above it
cases.protocol: splitTrial(0,4) then print the three resulting trials and deltas
cases.expect: pieces (0x100/4) and (0x104/8) both keep used/active; survivor slot increments by one; slotbase increments by one; trial count 3

observation_schema.format: 42 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, six case headers, then per-case observation rows (pp/uc/ae/sorted[]/hi/lo/lo8/st[]/deltas)
observation_schema.find_entry: possibleParamWithSlot hit boolean plus the Ghidra slot/slotsize arithmetic, discriminating register/stack hits from const/unique/ram cross-offset misses and the minsize gate
observation_schema.no_filter_predicates: unjustifiedContainer returns the entry container triple; assumedExtension returns the opcode name and container; register-entry answers prove the removed Ram filter
observation_schema.sort_ladder: post-sort rows expose group order, exclusion offset order, reverseStack address order and the entry-less tail
observation_schema.splits: hi/lo rows print (space,offset,size), slot deltas and used/active/checked flag inheritance; split_trial rows add survivor slot delta, slotbase delta and trial count
observation_schema.slots: slot observations are deltas from the pre-split values; the absolute 1-vs-0 base is a registered residual, not an observation

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: findEntry returns the first matching entry (per-space resolver order = entry declaration order); unjustifiedContainer/assumedExtension pass back VarnodeData containers by mutation; splitHi/splitLo return new ParamTrial values with the full flags word copied (fspec.cc:1849/1861); splitTrial replaces the trial vector in place
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: findEntry walks only the query space's resolver ranges (resolverMap[space->getIndex()], populated by populateResolver fspec.cc:1191-1216); unjustifiedContainer/assumedExtension walk the whole entry list in declaration order with no space filter (fspec.cc:1414/1429); sortTrials orders by operator< (group, entry pointer order, exclusion offset, reverseStack address, size)
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: registerTrial consumes slotbase (+1 per trial, fspec.cc:1966-1975); splitTrial bumps slotbase once and renumbers every trial slot above the split (fspec.cc:2041-2055); joinTrial would decrement (not exercised)
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: operator< ladder exactly: null entry never less, then group id, then raw entry pointer (== std::list push_back allocation order == declaration order), then justified offset for exclusion entries, then reverseStack-inverted address for non-exclusion, then size
